blocks.html: Valentine’s Day may not be an official holiday but it sure is one of the most celebrated days of the year. This February, get into the spirit of the month of love as Robinsons Galleria sets you up on a Valentine’s weekend filled with kilig, music and more.

Single, dating or happily in love— everybody loves good music. On February 13, indulge in harmonies from one of country’s widely acclaimed musical ensembles: The Manila Philharmonic Orchestra serenades you with classical symphonies at 5pm, at the Robinsons Galleria Activity Area.

Be swept off your feet as BAILONA-- the newest love team that’s driving social media into a frenzy—performs for the first time in Robinsons Galleria. Bailey May and Ylona Garcia has charmed many with their candidness, raw talent and undeniable chemistry.

Catch #BAILONAatRobinsonsGalleria at the Activity Area, 5pm, as the cutest and most romantic pair sing their way to your hearts. To top off your Valentine’s celebration, get a chance to bag exclusive restaurant gift certificates, a dinner buffet for two at 7 corners restaurant or an overnight stay for two at Crowne Plaza Manila Galleria.

A minimum single receipt purchase of P1,000 from any* retail outlet of Robinsons Galleria from February 12 to 14 entitles you to join the raffle draw on February 29. Special discounts also await from partner merchants Nine West, Old Navy, Nothing but Water, Lay Bare, Proline and Automatic Center, to name a few.

For more updates on Robinsons Malls events and promos, follow Robinsons Malls at www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls or visit www.robinsonsmalls.com. *except service outlets such as utilities, telecommunications, travel, courier, real estate, insurance, banks, schools and medical/dental clinics
